Puna Kaukau

July 05, 2026

This is a chance to pay homage to Waitī, the whetū, star, associated to fresh water and fresh water food sources. Join us for karakia, some fun, some kai, and whakawhanaungatanga, bonding, AFTER our swim to acknowledge Waitī.

Te Awahou Foxton Community Board Meeting

July 06, 2026

There is the opportunity for people to speak to items on a Council Agenda. Requests must be lodged by 12 noon the day before the meeting.

Te Putanga mai o Matariki

Latest News

Chris Dyhrberg appointed founding CE of Central Districts Water

Published on June 29, 2026

Central Districts Water has appointed Chris Dyhrberg as its founding Chief Executive, marking a significant milestone as the new organisation moves closer to operating in a years’ time.

National Recognition for Horowhenua's Welcoming Communities

Published on June 24, 2026

Horowhenua District Council are celebrating national recognition after the district's Welcoming Communities Te Waharoa ki ngā Hapori Programme received a Highly Commended award in the Beca Award for Excellence in Placemaking at the 2026 Taituarā Local Government Excellence Awards.

New Pawmanent dog tags coming soon for Horowhenua dog owners

Published on June 09, 2026

Horowhenua District Council is introducing Pawmanent dog tags this year - a lifetime registration tag designed to stay with your dog for life.
